summary: Tested theme on all customer screens, category/service photos, orders tracking, new settings links and merchant category photos, on backend and frontend (375x667 web preview). Backend: tests/test_categories_theme_iter64.py passes 10 of 11. What works: /api/categories returns 7 of 7 categories with Unsplash photo URLs; GET /api/merchant/categories works for the merchant, returns 403 for a customer and 401/403 without login; a customer PUT returns 403; a merchant PUT of the image shows up in /api/categories right away (cache cleared). Failed: PUT on an id that does not exist returns 200. Also found: POST and DELETE on merchant categories do not clear the cache, so a new category stays hidden and a deleted one stays visible for up to 120s. Frontend: Home in dark mode has no white areas, cards and text follow the theme, and the category tiles show the real photos. Light mode is readable. A custom green/pink palette applies to Home, Services and the tab bar. Services shows 12 large photo cards (335x234) in theme colors, and tapping one opens /service/{id}. Orders follows the theme; a processing order shows track-order-{id}, which opens /track-order/{id} with the map, a progress bar and the address. Settings links work: driver-apply, affiliate-apply, my-affiliate and the competitions tab. As merchant, More > 'الأقسام وصورها' opens /merchant/categories with 7 cat-edit-{id} cards with photos. Remaining issues: the service detail page /service/[id] is hardcoded white in dark mode and shows an icon instead of the photo; Orders hides the track button and shows the raw status for the real dispatch statuses (ready_for_pickup, assigned, picked_up); 6 of 12 services use the same fallback photo and the 'Screen Repair' photo is a PC; Orders has a hardcoded light border in dark mode. Deprecated packages: none checked in these files. Auth: password hashes use bcrypt $2b$, lockout returns 429 after 5 failed logins, login uses a Bearer token (no app httpOnly cookie), and CORS is allow_origins=['*'] with credentials.

minor.issue: An id that does not exist (000000000000000000000000) returns 200 'Updated'. It should check matched_count and return 404. Reference: server.py:1844-1853

Neither clears the 'categories:v1' cache. Verified: a TEST category created by the merchant was missing from /api/categories, and after DELETE it was still listed. Only PUT clears the cache. Reference: server.py:1838-1859

The body is the full CategoryInput model with defaults, so a partial body (for example only image) resets color1/color2/order/published to their defaults. The frontend sends the full object so it works today, but the API is fragile. Better: exclude_unset or a partial model.
allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True (server.py:4174). This existed before this change.

ui_bugs.issue: Not themed: safe bg '#FFF', tabsBar '#FFF', expCard '#FFF', borders '#E5E7EB', hero LinearGradient ['#F4ECFF','#E7D6FF']. In dark/custom mode, tapping a service opens a white page. The hero also shows the icon instead of the service photo used on the Services list. Reference: app/service/[id].tsx:74,253,270,291

Trackable statuses are ['ready','in_transit','out_for_delivery','shipped','processing'], but the real dispatch flow (delivery.py / server.py:1959) uses ready_for_pickup -> assigned -> picked_up. The track button disappears exactly when a driver is assigned or picks up the order, and the status bar shows the raw English key because these statuses are not in the label map. Reference: app/orders.tsx:57,64

SVC_PHOTOS has no entries for icons flash, camera, cloud-download, volume-high, hardware-chip, home, so 6 of 12 services show the same 'construct' fallback photo. The 'phone-portrait' photo used for Screen Repair (photo-1597872200969) is a gaming PC with water cooling, not a phone screen. No service has images[] in the DB. Reference: app/(tabs)/services.tsx:14-22
service-search-btn and book-service-btn have no onPress and do nothing when tapped. Reference: app/(tabs)/services.tsx:49,59

issues: totalRow and returnBtn borderTopColor are hardcoded '#E4E4E7', which shows as a bright white line above Total in dark mode (orders.tsx:112,115)
The loading ActivityIndicator is hardcoded '#F5C518' instead of colors.brand
The loading View (services.tsx:42) has no backgroundColor, so it flashes white in dark mode
The header row overflows at 375px: the cart button past 'My home' is cut off at the right edge
Accent icons are hardcoded '#F5C518' (index.tsx:93,156,177,291,307,318,332,344) and ignore the custom brand color
One trending product (Huawei Mate 60 Pro) has an empty image
The back icon is 'chevron-forward' and points the wrong way in LTR (English) (merchant/categories.tsx:51)
Category names always use name_ar even when lang=en
The title and hint show Arabic before tSync resolves
Arabic glyphs rendered disconnected in headless Chromium; this is probably a font issue in the test environment, not confirmed on device
A logged-in customer must type name and phone again (affiliate-apply prefills them)
An empty bordered placeholder box sits in the top-right of the header
The empty-state text still says to apply from the 'Social' tab; it should point to the new 'Join as marketer' item in Settings

action_items: Theme app/service/[id].tsx with useTheme/colors (bg, tabs, cards, borders, hero gradient) and use the service photo (images[0] or the SVC_PHOTOS fallback) in the hero
orders.tsx: add ready_for_pickup, assigned, picked_up (and confirmed/preparing) to the trackable list and the status label map

services.tsx: add real photos for flash/camera/cloud-download/volume-high/hardware-chip/home and replace the phone-portrait photo with a real phone-screen repair image; consider seeding services.images; wire service-search-btn and book-service-btn
orders.tsx: replace '#E4E4E7' borders with colors.border; give the services.tsx loading View colors.background
Backend: clear the categories:v1 cache in POST and DELETE /merchant/categories; return 404 when PUT/DELETE match nothing; catch invalid ObjectId
Home header: fix the overflow at 375px width
merchant/categories.tsx: use a back chevron that follows RTL/LTR and show names by language
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 6978 lines; it should be split into modules
The cache only works because there is 1 uvicorn worker (in-memory TTLCache); with more workers, invalidation would need a shared store

The app language is en (app_lang). Settings menu testIDs are settings-{icon}: settings-car, settings-megaphone, settings-stats-chart, settings-trophy, settings-color-palette. Customer 0500000000 had no orders; use tests/ui_seed_iter64.py to create one. EXPO_BACKEND_URL is not in frontend/.env; the key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, so export EXPO_BACKEND_URL manually for pytest.
